repo.description:
## Impact

OpenBao supports restricting evaluation of policies that have identity metadata templating, when said metadata includes wildcard or path segments. When a policy grants access via a global explicit wildcard but has an explicit narrow denial based on a (forbidden) identity template, the denial would be silently dropped leading to a limited ACL bypass within the confines of the broader wildcard grant. This vulnerability is also reachable in cases where wildcard templating is not restricted though is less likely to occur.

In most cases, identity metadata is not controlled by an attacker but is set by an IDP which is explicitly and fully trusted by OpenBao.

In cases not related to restricted identity templating, this vulnerability would originally be from HashiCorp Vault.

## Patch

This vulnerability is patched in OpenBao v2.7.0 and v2.6.3.
repo.summary: Denied Wildcard Allows Limited ACL Bypass in OpenBao
